title: Senior Territory Sales Manager – Property & Casualty
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Senior Territory Sales Manager to drive profitable premium growth across the Connecticut Market.

This is a Senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports , reporting to the Regional Sales Manager. This position is responsible for developing and strengthening relationships with independent agents, brokers, and distribution partners; identifying market growth opportunities; delivering product and sales training; and partnering with internal teams to support profitable business growth.

The ideal candidates bring strong Property & Casualty insurance experience, a solid understanding of underwriting guidelines, and market dynamics, and established knowledge of the Connecticut insurance marketplace.

Candidates should reside in Connecticut, preferably within or near the Connecticut shoreline, and be comfortable traveling throughout the assigned territory.

This is a remote position.

Salary Range: $125,000 - $150,000 per year

What you will do:

Sales Growth & Market Expansion

• Drive premium volume growth by identifying and executing strategic sales opportunities within the assigned territory.

• Develop and strengthen relationships with agents, brokers and distribution partners to increase new business and expand existing relationships.

• Partner with the Regional Sales Manager to execute and refine territory sales strategies aligned with revenue and profitability goals.

• Develop strategies to attract new business while maintaining strong retention within existing agency relationships.

• Establish territory priorities and sales plans based on market opportunity, agency potential, and business objectives.

• Identify opportunities to increase market penetration, agency engagement, and product utilization.

Product Training & Sales Enablement

• Deliver product training to agents, brokers, and distribution partners to enhance product knowledge and sales effectiveness.

• Conduct in-person and virtual training sessions, ensuring alignment with company sales initiatives and market trends.

• Provide ongoing coaching and mentorship to improve partner engagement and sales performance.

• Communicate product enhancements, underwriting updates, sales initiatives, and market development to agency partners.

Market Analysis & Relationship Management

• Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with agents, brokers, and key market stakeholders throughout Connecticut.

• Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, agency needs and market conditions.

• Gather field feedback to help improve product, sales strategies, and the overall agency experience.

• Provide market intelligence and strategic insights to the Regional Sales Manager and internal business partners.

• Serve as a key liaison between the field and internal teams, sharing feedback to improve product offerings and customer experience.

Profitability & Compliance

• Maintain underwriting profitability by ensuring sales align with company guidelines and risk assessment protocols.

• Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with state regulations and company policies.

• Track and analyze sales data and performance metrics, reporting to the Regional Sales Manager regularly.

What you will bring: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

• A bachelor’s degree in marketing, finance, business, Insurance , or a related field is preferred, or equivalent experience in P&C insurance experience.

• 8+ years of relevant experience within the property & casualty insurance industry, preferably with a carrier.

• 5+ years of experience in territory sales, agency development, business development or a related agent/broker-facing role.

• Strong knowledge of P&C insurance products, underwriting guidelines, and sales strategies.

• Established knowledge of the Connecticut P&C market and relationships within the independent agency/broker community strongly preferred.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-buildin

• Provide high quality virtual speech-language therapy services to a wide variety of students in grades K-12 across multiple states

• Ensure that IEP, Evaluation and progress monitoring procedures adhere to the district, state and federal guidelines

• Collect ongoing daily data and adapt treatment accordingly based on trends in student performance

• Attend IEP and Evaluation meetings and provide necessary documentation for team to review in a timely manner

• Collaborate with classroom teachers and all other members of a student’s educational team

• Demonstrate knowledge of the Common Core Standards; aligning them with treatment objectives

• Facilitate effective student communication abilities across all modes and levels of language

• Participate in building based intervention processes to support students and teachers

• Develop functional use of district software for purposes of special education compliance and accountability reporting

About You

• Professional Ohio Speech Language Pathologist license is required

• Proficient in computer applications, including MS Office Suite, Google applications, e-mail, and internet applications; excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Strong content knowledge in one or more content areas

• Exhibit genuine care for children and a passion for teaching

• Strong ability to gather, analyze, and interpret student data to make sound educational decisions

• Exhibit flexibility with regard to decision-making, daily challenges, and job duties

• Has strong sense of integrity

• Has a “team player” attitude

• Ability to work in a diverse educational community setting

• Understanding of the community and student demographics

About Us
“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” - Ron Packard, CEO & Founder
ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. title: Product Manager - 4 Day Week + Remote

Do you know what product management is really about? If you do, then you know it isn't roadmaps, tickets or beautifully groomed backlogs. It's finding a real, expensive, unglamorous problem that people live with every day - and shipping something that makes it go away. That is product.
At Shape Construction, we are building software that transforms how construction projects are delivered. It's born out of real project experience and designed to bring clarity, structure and performance to complex environments.
The problem we are solving is one of the oldest in the industry: what actually happens on a construction site never makes it, intact, to the people who need it. Supervisors, field engineers and site managers see reality first: work blocked, plans deviated from, instructions given verbally, conditions nobody planned for. That knowledge lives in heads, notebooks, camera rolls and group chats. Meanwhile the people responsible for the commercial health of the project are working weeks behind, from whatever fragments they can piece together. By the time anyone needs to prove what happened, the evidence has gone cold.
We are building the platform that closes that gap. Tools the site genuinely wants to use, capturing what happens as it happens, and then turning that raw signal into structured, trustworthy records that let commercial and project leadership make decisions, hold their ground and protect margin they would otherwise have written off.
This is your opportunity to own a core part of that. You won't be handed a roadmap to administer, you'll shape it, defend it, and be measured on whether customers are genuinely better off. If you like being close to messy real-world problems, have strong opinions about what to build and the discipline to kill your own ideas when the evidence says so, keep reading.

Work From Anywhere in LATAM or the Philippines
Work Schedule: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST |US Timezone (Flexible) | Overlap with US business hours]
Compensation Range: $3,000 - $3,500 USD/month based on experience
A biotechnology company in the regenerative medicine and personal stem cell banking space is looking for a Business Systems Manager to lead a full CRM migration and take ownership of the systems that run the business.
Recently acquired and now modernizing its entire technology stack from the ground up, the company is a lean, bootstrapped team of roughly 20 to 50 people. Its current systems were inherited rather than designed, and today the setup depends on costly external developers with no internal owner to tie everything together.
Day-to-day, this role leads the migration from Salesforce to HubSpot or Zoho, keeps the existing client portal integration intact through the transition, and takes over maintenance of a laboratory information management system and patient database after handoff from an external development team. The role also identifies operational gaps and builds new integrations for front office and sales teams. Success means a consolidated, modern systems stack owned in-house that reduces dependence on outside developers.
Requirements

Must-Have

• 4-8 years in CRM administration or business systems administration, with end-to-end ownership of the systems (not part of a large specialist team)

• Hands-on experience leading at least one CRM migration from Salesforce to HubSpot or Zoho, including data migration, configuration, and platform build-out

• 2-3 years hands-on Salesforce administration (migration source platform)

• Cross-platform CRM experience spanning Salesforce and at least one of HubSpot or Zoho

• Multi-system integration experience connecting a CRM with portals, databases, or operational tools via API or middleware (Zapier, Make, Workato, or custom integrations)

• Experience independently taking over and maintaining technical systems handed off from external developers or vendors

• B2+ English (CEFR) for internal team and vendor coordination

Nice-to-Have

• LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System) experience

• Heroku platform familiarity

• Healthcare, biotech, or life sciences industry exposure

• HIPAA or healthcare data compliance awareness

• Experience supporting front office or sales operations teams

About Pearl Talent
Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. They're looking for the sharpest, hungriest candidates who they can consistently promote and work with over many years. Candidates we've hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US.

title: Telehealth Nurse Practitioner (NP) / APRN – Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT)
description:
Remote | 1099 | $60-$90/hour | Minimum 20 Hours/Week
AlediumHR is partnering with an established and growing telehealth healthcare organization focused on hormone health, preventative care, and performance-based wellness.
As the organization continues to expand nationally, we are seeking experienced Nurse Practitioners (NPs) and Advanced Practice Registered Nurses (APRNs) with hands-on experience in Hormone Replacement Therapy (HRT) to provide virtual care to male and female patients.
This opportunity is designed for experienced NP/APRN clinicians who understand hormone optimization and want to practice in a telehealth environment with technology, administrative support, and clinical infrastructure in place.
What You'll Do
As a Telehealth NP/APRN, you will manage patients throughout their hormone health journey, from initial evaluation through ongoing treatment and monitoring.
You will:

• Conduct comprehensive virtual consultations with male and female patients

• Review symptoms, medical histories, and laboratory results

• Evaluate and diagnose hormone-related conditions

• Develop individualized, evidence-based treatment plans

• Initiate and manage testosterone, estrogen, progesterone, and appropriate adjunct therapies

• Monitor patient progress and laboratory results and adjust treatment when clinically appropriate

• Educate patients on treatment options, expected outcomes, risks, benefits, and long-term health strategies

• Maintain accurate and compliant clinical documentation

• Work alongside an established clinical, administrative, technology, and patient-support team

What We're Looking For
This position requires previous clinical HRT experience. It is not an entry-level hormone health opportunity.
Required qualifications:

• Active Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) credentials

• Minimum 1 year of hands-on Hormone Replacement Therapy experience

• Experience treating both male and female patients

• Working knowledge of testosterone replacement therapy and female hormone optimization, including estrogen and progesterone therapies

• Experience interpreting hormone-related laboratory results and managing ongoing treatment protocols

• Active NP/APRN licenses in at least 6 U.S. states

• Active, unrestricted DEA registration

• Strong clinical judgment and comfort practicing independently in a virtual environment

• Excellent patient communication and documentation skills

• Why This Opportunity

Focus on patient care.
The organization provides the technology, administrative support, compliance infrastructure, and operational resources needed to support your patients and your practice.
100% remote.
Provide virtual care from home while serving patients across multiple states.
Flexible scheduling.
Scheduling flexibility is available, with a minimum commitment of 20 hours per week.
Established telehealth infrastructure.
Join a growing organization with the systems and support already in place to deliver hormone health and preventative wellness services nationwide.
Compensation
$60-$90 per hour, based on relevant HRT experience, qualifications, and the number of active state licenses held.
This is an independent contractor 1099 position.
Interested?
If you are an experienced NP or APRN with hands-on HRT experience and are looking for a flexible telehealth opportunity to focus on delivering high-quality patient care, we would like to hear from you.
Apply today to learn more about the opportunity and the clinical team.

The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

The Role

We're looking for a cross-disciplinary builder to own how our people data ecosystem comes together - from raw pipelines to predictive models to the agentic workflows that put insight into action. This is not a traditional People Analyst role. You won't just answer questions with dashboards; you'll design and build the end-to-end system that makes People data trustworthy, intelligent, and increasingly autonomous.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll lead through technical depth and craft rather than headcount - designing architecture, writing production code, and setting the technical bar for how People data and AI work at our company.

You'll operate at the intersection of data engineering , data science , people analytics , and agentic AI - fluent enough in each to see how the whole system connects, and hands-on enough to build the connective tissue yourself.

You Will

• Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines that unify people data across HRIS, ATS, performance, compensation, and engagement systems.

• Own the architecture that ties pipelines, models, and agents into one coherent system - and continuously evolve it as tools and needs change.

• Set the technical direction and standards for People data and AI, and raise the bar through code review, design docs, and mentorship of peers (leading by influence, not by managing a team).

• Partner with People, Data Platform, Security, and Legal to ensure the system is compliant, scalable, and genuinely useful.

You Have

• 8+ years of relevant experience

• Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks - building automations, prompts, tool-use, and evaluation loops.

• Strong systems thinking: you see how components connect and design for the whole, not just the part in front of you.

• Excellent communication - you can explain a model to an executive and a workflow to an engineer

Even Better

• Experience with people analytics platforms (Workday, Visier, etc.).

• Background in organizational network analysis or workforce planning.

title: AVP, Encounters

JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides strategy and leadership for team responsible for encounters activities including monitoring inbound and outbound encounters processes and ensuring timely, accurate and complete encounter submissions for low to moderate complexity markets or states. Facilitates data and process analysis, collaborates with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve root-causes of issues that impact encounters, and provides recommendations for improvements to enhance operational performance.
Essential Job Duties

• Supports strategy development, vision and direction for the encounters function. Demonstrates accountability for performance and financial results, and keeps executive leadership apprised.
• Demonstrates accountability for encounters accuracy and completeness (i.e., encounters production, audit, production vendor oversight) for assigned lines of business.
• Demonstrates accountability for increasing volume of encounters received from providers, improving completeness of encounter data with states, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), and the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to reconcile data.
• Ensures encounter submissions, rejection management and resolution for all lines of business including internal strategic partnerships supporting the production of encounters, demonstrates leadership and accountability to support management of overall health care costs.
• Actively participates in the hiring process, coordinates training and manages staff involved in creating controls, documents, and tools within the encounter process to manage work in assigned resources.
• Identifies, develops and trains direct reporting encounters staff and implements processes to standardize the overall end-to-end processing, management and accuracy of encounters, and works collaboratively with departments to implement process improvements that impact quality, timeliness, and accuracy of encounters processing.
• Facilitates ongoing monitoring and management resolution for potential penalties related to accuracy and timeliness of encounters submissions.
• Manages encounters-related/operational projects/initiatives that reduce administrative costs for Molina and/or providers, and identifies opportunities to ensure accuracy of encounters and support for management of organizational health care costs for all lines of business directly impacting risk revenue and quality compliance.
• Partners with encounters senior leadership to ensure alignment of business goals and objectives for cost-saving initiatives.
• Convenes encounters-related work groups and develops implementation plans with identified tasks, timelines and delegation to assigned parties, and executes and measures success accordingly.
• Partners with encounters, operations, and IT leadership to analyze the root-cause of variations to encounters, find/propose ways to improve upon performance results, identify potential risks to the organization and lead changes within encounters processes to support organizational needs for all lines of business.

description:

Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

As Sprinto scales globally, tax becomes more than a compliance function-it becomes a strategic advantage. Every new market we enter, every entity we build, and every commercial decision we make brings new tax considerations that need thoughtful, business-first solutions.

You'll own Sprinto 's global tax operations across direct tax, indirect tax, and cross-border compliance, ensuring we stay compliant while enabling the business to move quickly and confidently. From working with external advisors and regulators to partnering with Finance, Legal, and Leadership, you'll help build a tax function that's scalable, resilient, and ready for the next phase of Sprinto 's growth.

If you're looking for a role where you'll move beyond filings and become a strategic partner in building a global SaaS company, this is that opportunity.

Where you'll leave your mark?

•
Build a global tax engine - Design and strengthen tax processes that scale with Sprinto 's international growth, ensuring compliance keeps pace with business expansion-not the other way around.

•
Turn complexity into clarity - Navigate direct tax, indirect tax, withholding tax, and cross-border regulations across multiple jurisdictions, translating evolving regulations into practical business decisions.

•

•
Build systems, not spreadsheets - Continuously improve compliance processes, reporting, and automation so the tax function becomes more scalable, efficient, and resilient as Sprinto grows.

title: User Acquisition Manager (Performance)
description:
ABOUT US

Founded in the US in 2022 and now based in London, UK, Recraft is an AI tool for professional designers, illustrators, and marketers, setting a new standard for excellence in image generation.

We designed a tool that lets creators quickly generate and iterate original images, vector art, illustrations, icons, and 3D graphics with AI. Over 3 million users across 190+ countries have produced hundreds of millions of images using Recraft, and we're just getting started.

Join a universe of professional opportunities, develop and support large-scale projects, and shape the future of creativity. We are committed to making Recraft an essential, daily tool for every designer and setting the industry standard. Our mission is to ensure that creators can fully control their creative process with AI, providing them with innovative tools to turn ideas into reality.

If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, we want you on board!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Growth at Recraft is a numbers problem before it's a brand problem. We're looking for a UA Manager who owns paid acquisition end to end: setting up the channels, scaling spend without breaking payback, and knowing which lever moved the number. This is a hands-in-the-accounts role, not an agency-management one - and for the right person, a chance to build the performance marketing engine at Recraft from scratch and scale it toward $1M/month.

One thing to know about the model, because it shapes the job: we don't run a free trial. New users get a pack of free credits, and once they need more, the only way forward is a paid subscription. That means conversion often happens on day one, and the numbers that matter are free-to-paid conversion rate, renewal, and payback by cohort - not trial starts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own paid user acquisition on Meta first - account structure, targeting, bidding, budget pacing, and daily optimization. Meta is where the majority of the budget sits and where we expect the majority of your time to go.

- Open and scale the next channels as Meta matures: Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, App) and TikTok.

- Scale monthly spend aggressively while holding CAC, ROAS, and cohort payback targets. Growth without payback discipline doesn't count.

- Build what isn't there yet: tracking, attribution, naming conventions, dashboards, and reporting - so decisions are made on data everyone trusts.

- Own subscription economics, not vanity metrics: free-to-paid conversion, day-one subscription rate, renewal and churn by month, ARPPU, and LTV by cohort and by channel.

- Run a structured testing cadence on audiences, placements, bidding, and offers - and brief creative based on what the data says, working directly with our Creative Designer.

- Automate the repetitive parts of the job - reporting, pacing, anomaly alerts, creative rotation - using Claude and platform APIs, so your time goes to decisions rather than spreadsheets.

- Forecast and plan budget, and report weekly on spend, CAC, and payback to marketing and leadership.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join the Marketing team and work closely with our Performance Marketing Manager, Creative Designer, and the analytics and product teams. This is a role built around owning a number and bringing your own plan for hitting it, not executing someone else's media plan.

REQUIREMENTS

- 4+ years in user acquisition or performance marketing for a consumer subscription product - app, web, or both.

- Deep, hands-on Meta expertise. You've run Meta as a primary acquisition channel at meaningful spend, built the account structure yourself, and can explain how you handled the moments where scaling stopped working.

- You've managed a paid budget of at least $100k/month and can walk us through what CAC and payback did as you scaled it.

- Experience setting up performance marketing from scratch - accounts, pixels and server-side events, MMP/SKAN or GA4, attribution logic, and reporting.

- Fluency in subscription econ

title: Clinical Medical Monitor
description:

The Opportunity

Great clinical development depends on strong medical judgment in the moments that matter: when an investigator has a question, a safety event needs assessment, or emerging data require action. At Praxis, you’ll provide hands-on medical oversight for assigned clinical programs, with patient safety and study quality at the center. You’ll support investigators and sites on eligibility, dosing, safety events, and other medical questions; review clinical and safety data; assess serious adverse events; and identify emerging signals or trends. You’ll partner closely with clinical leads and cross-functional study teams while maintaining independent medical judgment. This is a role for someone who wants to stay close to the patients, sites, and data and make timely, thoughtful decisions that keep studies moving safely and effectively.

Primary Responsibilities

• Medical oversight: Provide timely medical guidance for assigned studies, including eligibility, dosing, protocol requirements, safety events, and other study-related medical questions.

• Clinical safety assessment: Review AEs and SAEs, assessing causality, severity, expectedness, clinical significance, and potential implications for patients and the program.

• Site support: Respond promptly and consistently to investigator and site medical questions, balancing patient safety, protocol requirements, and sound clinical judgment.

• Data surveillance: Review patient-level and aggregate clinical and safety data to identify trends, inconsistencies, emerging signals, and areas requiring follow-up.

• Safety and regulatory compliance: Ensure medical monitoring, safety assessment, escalation, and documentation meet applicable regulatory requirements, GCP standards, and study protocols.

• Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with clinical development, clinical operations, safety/pharmacovigilance, biostatistics, data management, and regulatory colleagues to resolve issues and support high-quality study execution.

• Independent judgment: Bring a clear medical perspective to decisions, challenge assumptions when warranted, and know what to escalate and when.

• MD or equivalent medical degree required; CNS or relevant therapeutic area experience preferred.

• Clinical trial experience with responsibility for medical monitoring, clinical safety, or related medical oversight. The position may be hired at the Director or Senior Director level based on the depth and breadth of relevant experience.

• Strong clinical judgment and demonstrated ability to assess AEs and SAEs consistently and rigorously.

• Experience responding to investigator and site medical questions and making timely decisions when information is incomplete.

• Ability to review clinical data, recognize meaningful patterns or potential safety signals, and determine when action or additional surveillance is needed.

• Working knowledge of GCP, clinical trial safety reporting requirements, and documentation standards.

• You’ll thrive here if you stay close to the work, communicate clearly, exercise independent judgment, and take ownership. You know when speed matters, when deeper investigation is needed, and when to escalate, all while keeping patient safety at the center.

- Provide ad hoc analysis and decision support across the business - building the case for investment, surfacing risks, and identifying opportunities.

title: Mid Market Account Executive, Toast Retail
description:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.
Role Overview
As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.
This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.
You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.
A day in the life (Responsibilities)

•
Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.

•
Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.

•
Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.

•
Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.

•
Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.

•
Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast 's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.

•
Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.

•
Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.

•
Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast 's bottom line.

•
Operational excellence: Maintain high standards o

title: Project Manager
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

LEAD / STRATEGISE / TRANSFORM.

SUMMARY:

As a Project Manager, you function as the "CEO of the Project," taking full accountability for Fixed-Fee discipline and the governance of complex technical lifecycles, including AI/ML and Lakehouse. You are a decisive facilitator with high situational awareness, providing value-based trade-off options when scope adjustments are needed.

WHY THIS ROLE?

- Leadership: Determine methods and procedures on new assignments and coordinate the activities of other personnel.

- Strategic Shift: This role represents a fundamental shift from managing tactical tasks to managing broader organizational outcomes.

- Complexity: Own high-visibility, strategic implementations for major enterprise accounts.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- High-Stakes Delivery: Manage complex, Fixed-Fee implementations with rigorous governance.

- Work Structures: Create granular Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and associate effort and resource naming to specific tasks.

- Financial Governance: Apply Critical Path Methodology (CPM) and Earned Value Management (EVM) for accurate risk forecasting.

- Cross-functional Alignment: Network with key contacts outside your own area of expertise to ensure delivery success.

- Continuous Improvement: Present "Lessons Learned" decks to regional teams to optimize future upstream pre-sales and scoping.

- Service Selling: Support pre-sales activities by identifying upsell opportunities and contributing to service scoping.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

- Typically 2-5 years of field experience in a services delivery or technical implementation role.

- Typically 5-8 years of related experience in technical project management.

- Experience in data engineering is a strong plus.

- Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.

- Advanced Smartsheet/Project modeling and the ability to query Snowflake metadata for consumption reporting.

- Professional working proficiency in English

- Demonstrated proficiency in EVM and CPM to identify and mitigate schedule/cost variances.

- SnowPro Core (required) and PMP preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку Senior/Lead User Acquisition Manager.

Які виклики чекають тебе:
- Безпосередній вплив на процеси задля зростання своєї зони та можливість запуску нових каналів
- Стати наставником для інших User Acquisition менеджерів та в перспективі залідити команду.
- Запуск та масштабування різних каналів: Meta/ Google/ TikTok/ Snapchat/ X/ Quora, etc
- Впровадження growth hacking стратегій та пошуку можливостей для стрімкого росту, а не на класичних схемах просування
- Оцінка результатів ефективності кампаній. Моніторити не тільки ключові маркетингові метрики (CTR, CR, CPA, ROI і т.д.), але й дивитися нижче по воронці і коригувати свою стратегію, базуючись на даних
- Дослідження конкурентів, аналіз їхніх рекламних каналів, матеріалів та підходів до залучення користувачів
- Робота з креативною командою для створення якісних рекламних креативів, що конвертять. Будеш ставити завдання для креативної команди, приймати участь у брейнштормах і оцінювати результат роботи дизайнерів
- Робота з продуктово-технічною командою для створення крутих воронок, що конвертять. Будемо досліджувати та покращувати user flow.

Що для нас важливо:
- Досвід роботи у маркетингу 4+ років;
- Практичний досвід у розробці та реалізації рекламних кампаній у Facebook/Google Ads;
- Розуміння маркетингових метрик, таких як CPM, CTR, CPC, CR, CPA, ROAS, ROI, LTV тощо та взаємозв’язки з фінансовими результатами компанії
- Підхід до прийняття рішень на основі даних. Сильні аналітичні здібності, вміння аналізувати великі обсяги інформації та робити з неї висновки;

Буде плюсом:
- Досвід 2+ роки на менеджерських посадах;
- Досвід роботи з Tik Tok Ads;

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

- Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань

At Yardzen, we believe people are at their best when they’re outside.
